name: Gina L. Lera
tagline: Top rated Estate Planning & Probate attorney in Sacramento, California
education: University of the Pacific McGeorge School of Law
about: Gina L. Lera is a top-rated attorney selected to Super Lawyers for 2012 - 2026. She works at Lera Tiberini PC, located in Sacramento, California, and provides legal services for issues involving Estate Planning & Probate and Estate & Trust Litigation to the surrounding community.
Gina Lera completed legal studies at University of the Pacific McGeorge School of Law and graduated with the class of 1995. Gina Lera passed the bar in 1995.

Only a few attorneys from each state are selected to Super Lawyers designation for any given year. The multi-factor selection process includes independent research, peer nominations and evaluations, as well as professional achievement in legal practice.
